verses: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ وَٱلنُّورَ ثُمَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ يَعْدِلُونَ
هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن طِينٍ ثُمَّ قَضَىٰٓ أَجَلًا وَأَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى عِندَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ تَمْتَرُونَ
وَهُوَ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَعْلَمُ سِرَّكُمْ وَجَهْرَكُمْ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُونَ
وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ مَّكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّكُمْ وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْهِم مِّدْرَارًا وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرَ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ كِتَٰبًا فِى قِرْطَاسٍ فَلَمَسُوهُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ لَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ وَلَوْ أَنزَلْنَا مَلَكًا لَّقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ ثُمَّ لَا يُنظَرُونَ
وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَٰهُ مَلَكًا لَّجَعَلْنَٰهُ رَجُلًا وَلَلَبَسْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّا يَلْبِسُونَ
وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ ٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

قُل لِّمَن مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ قُل لِّلَّهِ كَتَبَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ لَيَجْمَعَنَّكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
وَلَهُۥ مَا سَكَنَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
قُلْ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَتَّخِذُ وَلِيًّا فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ يُطْعِمُ وَلَا يُطْعَمُ قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
مَّن يُصْرَفْ عَنْهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمَهُۥ وَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
وَهُوَ ٱلْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِۦ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ

قُلْ أَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَكْبَرُ شَهَٰدَةً قُلِ ٱللَّهُ شَهِيدٌۢ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَأُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لِأُنذِرَكُم بِهِۦ وَمَنۢ بَلَغَ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً أُخْرَىٰ قُل لَّآ أَشْهَدُ قُلْ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ وَإِنَّنِى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يَعْرِفُونَهُۥ كَمَا يَعْرِفُونَ أَبْنَآءَهُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآؤُكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
ثُمَّ لَمْ تَكُن فِتْنَتُهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ وَٱللَّهِ رَبِّنَا مَا كُنَّا مُشْرِكِينَ
ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ

وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كُلَّ ءَايَةٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوكَ يُجَٰدِلُونَكَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
وَهُمْ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ وَيَنْـَٔوْنَ عَنْهُ وَإِن يُهْلِكُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ وُقِفُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَقَالُوا۟ يَٰلَيْتَنَا نُرَدُّ وَلَا نُكَذِّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّنَا وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
بَلْ بَدَا لَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُخْفُونَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَوْ رُدُّوا۟ لَعَادُوا۟ لِمَا نُهُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ وُقِفُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ هَٰذَا بِٱلْحَقِّ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا قَالَ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ

قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱللَّهِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً قَالُوا۟ يَٰحَسْرَتَنَا عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِيهَا وَهُمْ يَحْمِلُونَ أَوْزَارَهُمْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِمْ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ
وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَلَلدَّارُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
قَدْ نَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيَحْزُنُكَ ٱلَّذِى يَقُولُونَ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يُكَذِّبُونَكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
وَلَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَصَبَرُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا كُذِّبُوا۟ وَأُوذُوا۟ حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰهُمْ نَصْرُنَا وَلَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكَ مِن نَّبَإِى۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

وَإِن كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكَ إِعْرَاضُهُمْ فَإِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتَ أَن تَبْتَغِىَ نَفَقًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَوْ سُلَّمًا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَأْتِيَهُم بِـَٔايَةٍ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ
إِنَّمَا يَسْتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْمَعُونَ وَٱلْمَوْتَىٰ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ
وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُنَزِّلَ ءَايَةً وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا طَٰٓئِرٍ يَطِيرُ بِجَنَاحَيْهِ إِلَّآ أُمَمٌ أَمْثَالُكُم مَّا فَرَّطْنَا فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِن شَىْءٍ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يُحْشَرُونَ
وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا صُمٌّ وَبُكْمٌ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ مَن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يُضْلِلْهُ وَمَن يَشَأْ يَجْعَلْهُ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُ ٱللَّهِ أَوْ أَتَتْكُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَدْعُونَ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
بَلْ إِيَّاهُ تَدْعُونَ فَيَكْشِفُ مَا تَدْعُونَ إِلَيْهِ إِن شَآءَ وَتَنسَوْنَ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْبَأْسَآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
فَلَوْلَآ إِذْ جَآءَهُم بَأْسُنَا تَضَرَّعُوا۟ وَلَٰكِن قَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
فَلَمَّا نَسُوا۟ مَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَبْوَٰبَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَرِحُوا۟ بِمَآ أُوتُوٓا۟ أَخَذْنَٰهُم بَغْتَةً فَإِذَا هُم مُّبْلِسُونَ
فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ سَمْعَكُمْ وَأَبْصَٰرَكُمْ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُم مَّنْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِهِ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ ثُمَّ هُمْ يَصْدِفُونَ
قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُ ٱللَّهِ بَغْتَةً أَوْ جَهْرَةً هَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
وَمَا نُرْسِلُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ فَمَنْ ءَامَنَ وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ

قُل لَّآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِندِى خَزَآئِنُ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَعْلَمُ ٱلْغَيْبَ وَلَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ إِنِّى مَلَكٌ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ أَفَلَا تَتَفَكَّرُونَ
وَأَنذِرْ بِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَن يُحْشَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ لَيْسَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ وَلِىٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ

وَلَا تَطْرُدِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلْعَشِىِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُۥ مَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ وَمَا مِنْ حِسَابِكَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَتَطْرُدَهُمْ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
وَكَذَٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ لِّيَقُولُوٓا۟ أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنۢ بَيْنِنَآ أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ

وَإِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَقُلْ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ أَنَّهُۥ مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنكُمْ سُوٓءًۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ وَلِتَسْتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
قُلْ إِنِّى نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ قُل لَّآ أَتَّبِعُ أَهْوَآءَكُمْ قَدْ ضَلَلْتُ إِذًا وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
قُلْ إِنِّى عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَكَذَّبْتُم بِهِۦ مَا عِندِى مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِنِ ٱلْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ يَقُصُّ ٱلْحَقَّ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْفَٰصِلِينَ
قُل لَّوْ أَنَّ عِندِى مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِۦ لَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

وَعِندَهُۥ مَفَاتِحُ ٱلْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْلَمُهَآ إِلَّا هُوَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَمَا تَسْقُطُ مِن وَرَقَةٍ إِلَّا يَعْلَمُهَا وَلَا حَبَّةٍ فِى ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا رَطْبٍ وَلَا يَابِسٍ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ

وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا جَرَحْتُم بِٱلنَّهَارِ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُكُمْ فِيهِ لِيُقْضَىٰٓ أَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
وَهُوَ ٱلْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيُرْسِلُ عَلَيْكُمْ حَفَظَةً حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ تَوَفَّتْهُ رُسُلُنَا وَهُمْ لَا يُفَرِّطُونَ
ثُمَّ رُدُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَوْلَىٰهُمُ ٱلْحَقِّ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلْحُكْمُ وَهُوَ أَسْرَعُ ٱلْحَٰسِبِينَ
قُلْ مَن يُنَجِّيكُم مِّن ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ تَدْعُونَهُۥ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً لَّئِنْ أَنجَىٰنَا مِنْ هَٰذِهِۦ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُنَجِّيكُم مِّنْهَا وَمِن كُلِّ كَرْبٍ ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ

قُلْ هُوَ ٱلْقَادِرُ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابًا مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ أَوْ مِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِكُمْ أَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ شِيَعًا وَيُذِيقَ بَعْضَكُم بَأْسَ بَعْضٍ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَفْقَهُونَ
وَكَذَّبَ بِهِۦ قَوْمُكَ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ قُل لَّسْتُ عَلَيْكُم بِوَكِيلٍ
لِّكُلِّ نَبَإٍ مُّسْتَقَرٌّ وَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَخُوضُوا۟ فِى حَدِيثٍ غَيْرِهِۦ وَإِمَّا يُنسِيَنَّكَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فَلَا تَقْعُدْ بَعْدَ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
وَمَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ وَلَٰكِن ذِكْرَىٰ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ

وَذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ لَعِبًا وَلَهْوًا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَذَكِّرْ بِهِۦٓ أَن تُبْسَلَ نَفْسٌۢ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِىٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ وَإِن تَعْدِلْ كُلَّ عَدْلٍ لَّا يُؤْخَذْ مِنْهَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُبْسِلُوا۟ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ لَهُمْ شَرَابٌ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ وَعَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ

قُلْ أَنَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُنَا وَلَا يَضُرُّنَا وَنُرَدُّ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَابِنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ كَٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَهْوَتْهُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ حَيْرَانَ لَهُۥٓ أَصْحَٰبٌ يَدْعُونَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَى ٱئْتِنَا قُلْ إِنَّ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ هُوَ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَأُمِرْنَا لِنُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
وَأَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ

وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ كُن فَيَكُونُ قَوْلُهُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ ءَازَرَ أَتَتَّخِذُ أَصْنَامًا ءَالِهَةً إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكَ وَقَوْمَكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُوقِنِينَ
فَلَمَّا جَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلَّيْلُ رَءَا كَوْكَبًا قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّى فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَآ أُحِبُّ ٱلْءَافِلِينَ
فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلْقَمَرَ بَازِغًا قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّى فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَئِن لَّمْ يَهْدِنِى رَبِّى لَأَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلشَّمْسَ بَازِغَةً قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّى هَٰذَآ أَكْبَرُ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَتْ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

وَحَآجَّهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ قَالَ أَتُحَٰٓجُّوٓنِّى فِى ٱللَّهِ وَقَدْ هَدَىٰنِ وَلَآ أَخَافُ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ رَبِّى شَيْـًٔا وَسِعَ رَبِّى كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًا أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
وَكَيْفَ أَخَافُ مَآ أَشْرَكْتُمْ وَلَا تَخَافُونَ أَنَّكُمْ أَشْرَكْتُم بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ عَلَيْكُمْ سُلْطَٰنًا فَأَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ أَحَقُّ بِٱلْأَمْنِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنَهُم بِظُلْمٍ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلْأَمْنُ وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
وَتِلْكَ حُجَّتُنَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجَٰتٍ مَّن نَّشَآءُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ

وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ كُلًّا هَدَيْنَا وَنُوحًا هَدَيْنَا مِن قَبْلُ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِۦ دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَيُّوبَ وَيُوسُفَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
وَزَكَرِيَّا وَيَحْيَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَإِلْيَاسَ كُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَيُونُسَ وَلُوطًا وَكُلًّا فَضَّلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
وَمِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمْ وَإِخْوَٰنِهِمْ وَٱجْتَبَيْنَٰهُمْ وَهَدَيْنَٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَلَوْ أَشْرَكُوا۟ لَحَبِطَ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ فَإِن يَكْفُرْ بِهَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ فَقَدْ وَكَّلْنَا بِهَا قَوْمًا لَّيْسُوا۟ بِهَا بِكَٰفِرِينَ
أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ فَبِهُدَىٰهُمُ ٱقْتَدِهْ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَٰلَمِينَ

وَمَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ إِذْ قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ بَشَرٍ مِّن شَىْءٍ قُلْ مَنْ أَنزَلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلَّذِى جَآءَ بِهِۦ مُوسَىٰ نُورًا وَهُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ تَجْعَلُونَهُۥ قَرَاطِيسَ تُبْدُونَهَا وَتُخْفُونَ كَثِيرًا وَعُلِّمْتُم مَّا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنتُمْ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ذَرْهُمْ فِى خَوْضِهِمْ يَلْعَبُونَ

وَهَٰذَا كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ مُبَارَكٌ مُّصَدِّقُ ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَلِتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ

وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ قَالَ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ وَلَمْ يُوحَ إِلَيْهِ شَىْءٌ وَمَن قَالَ سَأُنزِلُ مِثْلَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ فِى غَمَرَٰتِ ٱلْمَوْتِ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ بَاسِطُوٓا۟ أَيْدِيهِمْ أَخْرِجُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ غَيْرَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَكُنتُمْ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ

وَلَقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا فُرَٰدَىٰ كَمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَتَرَكْتُم مَّا خَوَّلْنَٰكُمْ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِكُمْ وَمَا نَرَىٰ مَعَكُمْ شُفَعَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ أَنَّهُمْ فِيكُمْ شُرَكَٰٓؤُا۟ لَقَد تَّقَطَّعَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنكُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ فَالِقُ ٱلْحَبِّ وَٱلنَّوَىٰ يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَمُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتِ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
فَالِقُ ٱلْإِصْبَاحِ وَجَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ سَكَنًا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ حُسْبَانًا ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلنُّجُومَ لِتَهْتَدُوا۟ بِهَا فِى ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ فَمُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمُسْتَوْدَعٌ قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَفْقَهُونَ

وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ نَبَاتَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ فَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهُ خَضِرًا نُّخْرِجُ مِنْهُ حَبًّا مُّتَرَاكِبًا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّخْلِ مِن طَلْعِهَا قِنْوَانٌ دَانِيَةٌ وَجَنَّٰتٍ مِّنْ أَعْنَابٍ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلرُّمَّانَ مُشْتَبِهًا وَغَيْرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٍ ٱنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ثَمَرِهِۦٓ إِذَآ أَثْمَرَ وَيَنْعِهِۦٓ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكُمْ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ ٱلْجِنَّ وَخَلَقَهُمْ وَخَرَقُوا۟ لَهُۥ بَنِينَ وَبَنَٰتٍۭ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
بَدِيعُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لَهُۥ وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ تَكُن لَّهُۥ صَٰحِبَةٌ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
لَّا تُدْرِكُهُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ وَهُوَ يُدْرِكُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
قَدْ جَآءَكُم بَصَآئِرُ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ فَمَنْ أَبْصَرَ فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَنْ عَمِىَ فَعَلَيْهَا وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيْكُم بِحَفِيظٍ
وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ وَلِيَقُولُوا۟ دَرَسْتَ وَلِنُبَيِّنَهُۥ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
ٱتَّبِعْ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَآ أَشْرَكُوا۟ وَمَا جَعَلْنَٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ

وَلَا تَسُبُّوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَسُبُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَدْوًۢا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ كَذَٰلِكَ زَيَّنَّا لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ عَمَلَهُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِم مَّرْجِعُهُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ لَئِن جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَةٌ لَّيُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهَا قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْءَايَٰتُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا يُشْعِرُكُمْ أَنَّهَآ إِذَا جَآءَتْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
وَنُقَلِّبُ أَفْـِٔدَتَهُمْ وَأَبْصَٰرَهُمْ كَمَا لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَنَذَرُهُمْ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

وَلَوْ أَنَّنَا نَزَّلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ وَكَلَّمَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَحَشَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ قُبُلًا مَّا كَانُوا۟ لِيُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَجْهَلُونَ

وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّا شَيَٰطِينَ ٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلْجِنِّ يُوحِى بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ زُخْرُفَ ٱلْقَوْلِ غُرُورًا وَلَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ مَا فَعَلُوهُ فَذَرْهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُونَ
وَلِتَصْغَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ أَفْـِٔدَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَلِيَرْضَوْهُ وَلِيَقْتَرِفُوا۟ مَا هُم مُّقْتَرِفُونَ

أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَبْتَغِى حَكَمًا وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مُفَصَّلًا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُۥ مُنَزَّلٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ
وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ صِدْقًا وَعَدْلًا لَّا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
وَإِن تُطِعْ أَكْثَرَ مَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يُضِلُّوكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ مَن يَضِلُّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
فَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا ذُكِرَ ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُم بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ

وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تَأْكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا ذُكِرَ ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَقَدْ فَصَّلَ لَكُم مَّا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِلَّا مَا ٱضْطُرِرْتُمْ إِلَيْهِ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا لَّيُضِلُّونَ بِأَهْوَآئِهِم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
وَذَرُوا۟ ظَٰهِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَبَاطِنَهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْسِبُونَ ٱلْإِثْمَ سَيُجْزَوْنَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَقْتَرِفُونَ

وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا لَمْ يُذْكَرِ ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِسْقٌ وَإِنَّ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ لَيُوحُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَوْلِيَآئِهِمْ لِيُجَٰدِلُوكُمْ وَإِنْ أَطَعْتُمُوهُمْ إِنَّكُمْ لَمُشْرِكُونَ

أَوَمَن كَانَ مَيْتًا فَأَحْيَيْنَٰهُ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُۥ نُورًا يَمْشِى بِهِۦ فِى ٱلنَّاسِ كَمَن مَّثَلُهُۥ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ لَيْسَ بِخَارِجٍ مِّنْهَا كَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ أَكَٰبِرَ مُجْرِمِيهَا لِيَمْكُرُوا۟ فِيهَا وَمَا يَمْكُرُونَ إِلَّا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ

وَإِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَةٌ قَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ حَتَّىٰ نُؤْتَىٰ مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ رُسُلُ ٱللَّهِ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ حَيْثُ يَجْعَلُ رِسَالَتَهُۥ سَيُصِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ صَغَارٌ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَمْكُرُونَ

فَمَن يُرِدِ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَهْدِيَهُۥ يَشْرَحْ صَدْرَهُۥ لِلْإِسْلَٰمِ وَمَن يُرِدْ أَن يُضِلَّهُۥ يَجْعَلْ صَدْرَهُۥ ضَيِّقًا حَرَجًا كَأَنَّمَا يَصَّعَّدُ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّجْسَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
وَهَٰذَا صِرَٰطُ رَبِّكَ مُسْتَقِيمًا قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
لَهُمْ دَارُ ٱلسَّلَٰمِ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ قَدِ ٱسْتَكْثَرْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ وَقَالَ أَوْلِيَآؤُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ رَبَّنَا ٱسْتَمْتَعَ بَعْضُنَا بِبَعْضٍ وَبَلَغْنَآ أَجَلَنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَجَّلْتَ لَنَا قَالَ ٱلنَّارُ مَثْوَىٰكُمْ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُوَلِّى بَعْضَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَعْضًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنكُمْ يَقُصُّونَ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتِى وَيُنذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَا قَالُوا۟ شَهِدْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِنَا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَشَهِدُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ كَٰفِرِينَ
ذَٰلِكَ أَن لَّمْ يَكُن رَّبُّكَ مُهْلِكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ بِظُلْمٍ وَأَهْلُهَا غَٰفِلُونَ
وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجَٰتٌ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوا۟ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ذُو ٱلرَّحْمَةِ إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفْ مِنۢ بَعْدِكُم مَّا يَشَآءُ كَمَآ أَنشَأَكُم مِّن ذُرِّيَّةِ قَوْمٍ ءَاخَرِينَ
إِنَّ مَا تُوعَدُونَ لَءَاتٍ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
قُلْ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّى عَامِلٌ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن تَكُونُ لَهُۥ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلدَّارِ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ مِمَّا ذَرَأَ مِنَ ٱلْحَرْثِ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ نَصِيبًا فَقَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا لِلَّهِ بِزَعْمِهِمْ وَهَٰذَا لِشُرَكَآئِنَا فَمَا كَانَ لِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ فَلَا يَصِلُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ فَهُوَ يَصِلُ إِلَىٰ شُرَكَآئِهِمْ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ

وَكَذَٰلِكَ زَيَّنَ لِكَثِيرٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ قَتْلَ أَوْلَٰدِهِمْ شُرَكَآؤُهُمْ لِيُرْدُوهُمْ وَلِيَلْبِسُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ دِينَهُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا فَعَلُوهُ فَذَرْهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُونَ

وَقَالُوا۟ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَنْعَٰمٌ وَحَرْثٌ حِجْرٌ لَّا يَطْعَمُهَآ إِلَّا مَن نَّشَآءُ بِزَعْمِهِمْ وَأَنْعَٰمٌ حُرِّمَتْ ظُهُورُهَا وَأَنْعَٰمٌ لَّا يَذْكُرُونَ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا ٱفْتِرَآءً عَلَيْهِ سَيَجْزِيهِم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ

وَقَالُوا۟ مَا فِى بُطُونِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ خَالِصَةٌ لِّذُكُورِنَا وَمُحَرَّمٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَإِن يَكُن مَّيْتَةً فَهُمْ فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ سَيَجْزِيهِمْ وَصْفَهُمْ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَتَلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَٰدَهُمْ سَفَهًۢا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَحَرَّمُوا۟ مَا رَزَقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱفْتِرَآءً عَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَدْ ضَلُّوا۟ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ

وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ جَنَّٰتٍ مَّعْرُوشَٰتٍ وَغَيْرَ مَعْرُوشَٰتٍ وَٱلنَّخْلَ وَٱلزَّرْعَ مُخْتَلِفًا أُكُلُهُۥ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلرُّمَّانَ مُتَشَٰبِهًا وَغَيْرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٍ كُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦٓ إِذَآ أَثْمَرَ وَءَاتُوا۟ حَقَّهُۥ يَوْمَ حَصَادِهِۦ وَلَا تُسْرِفُوٓا۟ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
وَمِنَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ حَمُولَةً وَفَرْشًا كُلُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ

ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍ مِّنَ ٱلضَّأْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَمِنَ ٱلْمَعْزِ ٱثْنَيْنِ قُلْ ءَآلذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ أَمِ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ أَمَّا ٱشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ أَرْحَامُ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ نَبِّـُٔونِى بِعِلْمٍ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

وَمِنَ ٱلْإِبِلِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَمِنَ ٱلْبَقَرِ ٱثْنَيْنِ قُلْ ءَآلذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ أَمِ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ أَمَّا ٱشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ أَرْحَامُ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ أَمْ كُنتُمْ شُهَدَآءَ إِذْ وَصَّىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا لِّيُضِلَّ ٱلنَّاسَ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

قُل لَّآ أَجِدُ فِى مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ مُحَرَّمًا عَلَىٰ طَاعِمٍ يَطْعَمُهُۥٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَكُونَ مَيْتَةً أَوْ دَمًا مَّسْفُوحًا أَوْ لَحْمَ خِنزِيرٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ رِجْسٌ أَوْ فِسْقًا أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ حَرَّمْنَا كُلَّ ذِى ظُفُرٍ وَمِنَ ٱلْبَقَرِ وَٱلْغَنَمِ حَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ شُحُومَهُمَآ إِلَّا مَا حَمَلَتْ ظُهُورُهُمَآ أَوِ ٱلْحَوَايَآ أَوْ مَا ٱخْتَلَطَ بِعَظْمٍ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَيْنَٰهُم بِبَغْيِهِمْ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
فَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُل رَّبُّكُمْ ذُو رَحْمَةٍ وَٰسِعَةٍ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَأْسُهُۥ عَنِ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

سَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَآ أَشْرَكْنَا وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِن شَىْءٍ كَذَٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ ذَاقُوا۟ بَأْسَنَا قُلْ هَلْ عِندَكُم مِّنْ عِلْمٍ فَتُخْرِجُوهُ لَنَآ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَخْرُصُونَ
قُلْ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْحُجَّةُ ٱلْبَٰلِغَةُ فَلَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

قُلْ هَلُمَّ شُهَدَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَرَّمَ هَٰذَا فَإِن شَهِدُوا۟ فَلَا تَشْهَدْ مَعَهُمْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَهُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يَعْدِلُونَ

قُلْ تَعَالَوْا۟ أَتْلُ مَا حَرَّمَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ أَلَّا تُشْرِكُوا۟ بِهِۦ شَيْـًٔا وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَٰنًا وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَٰدَكُم مِّنْ إِمْلَٰقٍ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكُمْ وَإِيَّاهُمْ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ مَالَ ٱلْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَأَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَإِذَا قُلْتُمْ فَٱعْدِلُوا۟ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰ وَبِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْفُوا۟ ذَٰلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
وَأَنَّ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطِى مُسْتَقِيمًا فَٱتَّبِعُوهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلسُّبُلَ فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمْ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ذَٰلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
ثُمَّ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ تَمَامًا عَلَى ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْسَنَ وَتَفْصِيلًا لِّكُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لَّعَلَّهُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
وَهَٰذَا كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ مُبَارَكٌ فَٱتَّبِعُوهُ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
أَن تَقُولُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ عَلَىٰ طَآئِفَتَيْنِ مِن قَبْلِنَا وَإِن كُنَّا عَن دِرَاسَتِهِمْ لَغَٰفِلِينَ

أَوْ تَقُولُوا۟ لَوْ أَنَّآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَكُنَّآ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْهُمْ فَقَدْ جَآءَكُم بَيِّنَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَصَدَفَ عَنْهَا سَنَجْزِى ٱلَّذِينَ يَصْدِفُونَ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَصْدِفُونَ

هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِىَ رَبُّكَ أَوْ يَأْتِىَ بَعْضُ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَ يَأْتِى بَعْضُ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكَ لَا يَنفَعُ نَفْسًا إِيمَٰنُهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ ءَامَنَتْ مِن قَبْلُ أَوْ كَسَبَتْ فِىٓ إِيمَٰنِهَا خَيْرًا قُلِ ٱنتَظِرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مُنتَظِرُونَ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوا۟ شِيَعًا لَّسْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِى شَىْءٍ إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُمْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

evidence.text: Shared motifs, rarest first: God brings the living out of the dead and the dead out of the living (weight 6.0); I kill and I make alive, I wound and I heal; there is no god beside me (weight 5.1). Pair score 11.1.

Only in Splitter of seed and dawn; stars for navigation; do not revile their gods: Do not revile those they invoke besides God, lest they revile God in ignorance; They made the jinn partners of God, though he created them; Humans have a lodging place and a repository (mustaqarr wa-mustawdaʿ); Opponents say to the Prophet 'you have studied' (darasta); Rain brings forth vegetation: clustered grain, hanging date clusters, vineyards, olives and pomegranates; God is the splitter of the dawn (fāliq al-iṣbāḥ); night for rest; God splits the grain and the date-stone; Vision does not grasp him, but he grasps all vision; Do not revile God or curse a ruler of your people; God has taken neither consort (sahiba) nor child; God made the stars for guidance in the darknesses of land and sea; No human can see God's face and live; and 4 more.

Only in 'You only have I known'; the lion has roared: Chain of rhetorical questions of cause and effect (do two walk together unless agreed? does a lion roar without prey?); 'You only have I known of all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities'; God does nothing without revealing his secret (sod) to his servants the prophets; The horns of the altar of Bethel will be cut off and fall to the ground; 'The lion has roared, who will not fear? Only in Eat what God's name is spoken over; the opened breast; jinn and humans judged: Parable: one who was dead whom God revived and gave a light to walk among people; God knows best where to place his message; In every town God placed its great criminals to plot there; Jinn led many humans astray; their human allies say 'we profited from one another'; Messengers came to both jinn and humans 'from among you'; Paradise as the abode of peace (dār al-salām); God opens the breast of the guided to Islam; the astray's breast is tight, as if climbing into the sky; Every prophet has enemies: devils of humans and jinn inspiring one another with gilded speech; Eat only what God's name was pronounced over; what was slaughtered without it is forbidden; The people walking in darkness have seen a great light; on those in the land of deathly shadow light has shone; Forbidden food is permitted to one compelled by necessity, without desire or transgression; If God wills he takes you away and brings another people in your place.

matches.note: Blood that is poured out. Deut: raq ha-dām lōʾ tōʾkhēlû ʿal-hā-ʾāreṣ tišpəkhennû kam-māyim. Q: aw daman masfūḥan, only 'poured-out blood' is forbidden, the same image of shed blood (s-f-ḥ / š-f-k).

passages.text: רַ֥ק הַדָּ֖ם לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑לוּ עַל הָאָ֥רֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶ֖נּוּ כַּמָּֽיִם

قُل لَّآ أَجِدُ فِى مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ مُحَرَّمًا عَلَىٰ طَاعِمٍ يَطْعَمُهُۥٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَكُونَ مَيْتَةً أَوْ دَمًا مَّسْفُوحًا أَوْ لَحْمَ خِنزِيرٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ رِجْسٌ أَوْ فِسْقًا أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

matches.label: Nations burn their sons and daughters in fire to their gods
matches.note: Deut: kî gam ʾet-bənêhem wə-ʾet-bənōtêhem yiśrəfû vā-ʾēš lē-ʾlōhêhem. Q: zayyana li-kathīrin mina l-mushrikīna qatla awlādihim shurakāʾuhum; qad khasira lladhīna qatalū awlādahum safahan bi-ghayri ʿilmin. Both blame the false gods. Q does not mention fire (cf. Arabian infanticide).

passages.text: לֹא תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה כֵ֔ן לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כִּי֩ כָּל תּוֹעֲבַ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂנֵ֗א עָשׂוּ֙ לֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם כִּ֣י גַ֤ם אֶת בְּנֵיהֶם֙ וְאֶת בְּנֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם יִשְׂרְפ֥וּ בָאֵ֖שׁ לֵֽאלֹהֵיהֶֽם

وَكَذَٰلِكَ زَيَّنَ لِكَثِيرٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ قَتْلَ أَوْلَٰدِهِمْ شُرَكَآؤُهُمْ لِيُرْدُوهُمْ وَلِيَلْبِسُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ دِينَهُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا فَعَلُوهُ فَذَرْهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُونَ
قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَتَلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَٰدَهُمْ سَفَهًۢا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَحَرَّمُوا۟ مَا رَزَقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱفْتِرَآءً عَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَدْ ضَلُّوا۟ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ

leads.title: Mourning rites forbidden; clean and unclean food; tithes ↔ Pagan portions and taboos; eight pairs; what is forbidden to all and to the Jews
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 answers the other.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/02-hb-quran.yaml).

Shared motifs, rarest first: List of clean and unclean animals: split hoof and chewing cud [response between the texts] (weight 6.7); List of clean and unclean animals: split hoof and chewing cud (weight 6.3); The pig is unclean and forbidden (weight 5.3). Pair score 18.3.

Only in Mourning rites forbidden; clean and unclean food; tithes: Animal that died of itself may be given to the resident alien or sold to a foreigner; If the place is far, convert the tithe to silver and buy what you desire there, wine and strong drink included; Annual tithe eaten by the owner before God at the chosen place; Who receives the sacred levy for the needy [divergence between the texts]; Israel called sons of God [response between the texts]; Fay' (booty gained without cavalry or camels) goes to God, the messenger, kin, orphans, the poor and the wayfarer, so wealth does not circulate only among the rich; A fifth of all spoils goes to God, the messenger, kin, orphans, the poor and the wayfarer; Water creatures are permitted only if they have fins and scales; From palms and vines people take an intoxicant (sakar) and good provision; The pig is unclean and forbidden [divergence between the texts]; Every third year the tithe is stored in the towns for Levite, stranger, orphan and widow; List of unclean birds (eagle, vulture, raven, owl, stork, hoopoe, bat); and 5 more.

Only in Pagan portions and taboos; eight pairs; what is forbidden to all and to the Jews: Pagans set apart cattle whose backs may not be ridden or burdened; Eight in pairs: sheep, goats, camels and cattle, male and female; which did God forbid?; Idolaters say 'had God willed we would not have associated partners nor forbidden anything'; Give its due on the day of harvest; For the Jews God forbade every animal with claws/undivided hoof and the fat of cattle and sheep except on backs, entrails or bone; Do not be wasteful; God does not love the wasteful (musrifīn); Pagans assign a portion of crops and cattle to God and a portion to their partners; Pagans declare certain cattle and crops taboo (ḥijr), to be eaten only by whom they will; Pagans reserve what is in the wombs of cattle for males, forbidden to wives unless stillborn; The camel is unclean because it does not have a split hoof [contrast between the texts]; The fat tail of the sheep is offered [divergence between the texts]; Firstborn male of herd and flock consecrated to God, not worked or shorn; and 10 more.

אַ֣ךְ אֶת זֶ֞ה לֹ֤א תֹֽאכְלוּ֙ מִמַּֽעֲלֵ֣י הַגֵּרָ֔ה וּמִמַּפְרִיסֵ֥י הַפַּרְסָ֖ה הַשְּׁסוּעָ֑ה אֶֽת הַ֠גָּמָל וְאֶת הָאַרְנֶ֨בֶת וְאֶת הַשָּׁפָ֜ן כִּֽי מַעֲלֵ֧ה גֵרָ֣ה הֵ֗מָּה וּפַרְסָה֙ לֹ֣א הִפְרִ֔יסוּ טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶֽם

ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍ مِّنَ ٱلضَّأْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَمِنَ ٱلْمَعْزِ ٱثْنَيْنِ قُلْ ءَآلذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ أَمِ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ أَمَّا ٱشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ أَرْحَامُ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ نَبِّـُٔونِى بِعِلْمٍ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

وَمِنَ ٱلْإِبِلِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَمِنَ ٱلْبَقَرِ ٱثْنَيْنِ قُلْ ءَآلذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ أَمِ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ أَمَّا ٱشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ أَرْحَامُ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ أَمْ كُنتُمْ شُهَدَآءَ إِذْ وَصَّىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا لِّيُضِلَّ ٱلنَّاسَ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ حَرَّمْنَا كُلَّ ذِى ظُفُرٍ وَمِنَ ٱلْبَقَرِ وَٱلْغَنَمِ حَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ شُحُومَهُمَآ إِلَّا مَا حَمَلَتْ ظُهُورُهُمَآ أَوِ ٱلْحَوَايَآ أَوْ مَا ٱخْتَلَطَ بِعَظْمٍ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَيْنَٰهُم بِبَغْيِهِمْ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ

leads.title: Levitical dues; forbidden divination; the prophet like Moses ↔ Abraham's line of eighteen prophets; Torah in sheets; the false claimant
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 deliberately changed.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/02-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: False prophet put to death [divergence between the texts] (weight 6.3); False prophet put to death (weight 5.8). Pair score 12.1.

Only in Levitical dues; forbidden divination; the prophet like Moses: Be wholehearted (tamim) with God; A prophecy that does not come true shows the prophet spoke presumptuously; Priest's due: shoulder, two cheeks and stomach of the sacrifice, and first of the fleece; Duty to accept a prophet God will send later [divergence between the texts]; How God's word reaches the prophet [divergence between the texts]; A future prophet promised in the earlier scripture [response between the texts]; A future prophet 'from among them' [divergence between the texts]; Where false words in a prophet's message come from, and what becomes of them [contrast between the texts]; Whether the dead may be consulted, or would persuade the living if they spoke [contrast between the texts]; God sent before only men, inspired, from the people of the towns; Messengers are sent to people from among themselves; People fear to hear God directly and ask the prophet to mediate; and 8 more.

Only in Abraham's line of eighteen prophets; Torah in sheets; the false claimant: Opponents say 'God has sent down nothing to any human'; The intercessors they claimed as partners are not seen with them; ties are cut; They make Moses' book into sheets (qarāṭīs), showing some and hiding much; Catalogue of prophets who received revelation, from Noah to Jesus; None more wrong than one who falsely claims revelation or says he can send down the like of God's; 'How can you say We are wise, and the Torah of YHWH is with us?' The lying pen of the scribes has made it a lie; The prophet is sent to warn 'the mother of towns' (umm al-qura, Mecca) and those around it; 'Naked I came from my mother's womb and naked I shall return there'; The Torah contains guidance and light; Angels (God's messengers) take the souls of the dying; If God wills he takes you away and brings another people in your place; The Prophet asks no wage for the message.

Shared motifs, rarest first: If God wills he takes you away and brings another people in your place (weight 4.9). Pair score 4.9.

Only in Not for your righteousness; the golden calf and Moses' intercession recalled: Land given not for Israel's righteousness but for the nations' wickedness; Intercession appeals to what the nations would say of God; Calf burned, ground to dust, and the dust thrown into the stream; Moses intercedes for Aaron, with whom God was angry enough to destroy him; Moses prays for Aaron after the calf [divergence between the texts]; Tablets written by the finger of God; Aaron warns the people against the calf; they refuse to stop until Moses returns [divergence between the texts]; Cities 'great and fortified up to heaven'; God offers to destroy the people and make a nation of the hero instead; The prophet neither eats nor drinks for forty days; Prophet intercedes and averts God's destruction of the people; The prophet breaks the tablets in anger at the idolatry; and 7 more.

Only in Eat what God's name is spoken over; the opened breast; jinn and humans judged: Parable: one who was dead whom God revived and gave a light to walk among people; God knows best where to place his message; In every town God placed its great criminals to plot there; Jinn led many humans astray; their human allies say 'we profited from one another'; Messengers came to both jinn and humans 'from among you'; Paradise as the abode of peace (dār al-salām); God opens the breast of the guided to Islam; the astray's breast is tight, as if climbing into the sky; Every prophet has enemies: devils of humans and jinn inspiring one another with gilded speech; Eat only what God's name was pronounced over; what was slaughtered without it is forbidden; The people walking in darkness have seen a great light; on those in the land of deathly shadow light has shone; Forbidden food is permitted to one compelled by necessity, without desire or transgression; God does not punish a people before sending a messenger, lest they plead they had none.

matches.note: God can remove a people and raise another. Deut: hereph mimmennî wə-ʾašmîdēm ... wə-ʾeʿĕśeh ʾôtəkhā lə-gôy ʿāṣûm wā-rāv mimmennû. leads.title: Bureaucratic oppression, the love of money and wealth that perishes ↔ Abraham's line of eighteen prophets; Torah in sheets; the false claimant
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 same element.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/02-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: 'Naked I came from my mother's womb and naked I shall return there' (weight 6.3). Pair score 6.3.

Only in Bureaucratic oppression, the love of money and wealth that perishes: He will not much remember the days of his life because God keeps him occupied with the joy of his heart; When goods increase, those who eat them increase; the owner only sees them with his eyes; The profit of the land is for all; a king is for (served by) the cultivated field; Sweet is the sleep of the laborer whether he eats little or much, but the surfeit of the rich will not let him sleep; He who loves silver will not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance with income; If you see oppression of the poor in a province, do not be amazed: a high one watches over a high one, and higher ones over them; Riches kept by their owner to his hurt, lost in a bad venture, so that his son has nothing in hand; What profit (yitron) has a man from all his toil under the sun?; There is nothing better than to eat, drink and find enjoyment in one's toil; this is from the hand of God.

Only in Abraham's line of eighteen prophets; Torah in sheets; the false claimant: Opponents say 'God has sent down nothing to any human'; The intercessors they claimed as partners are not seen with them; ties are cut; They make Moses' book into sheets (qarāṭīs), showing some and hiding much; Catalogue of prophets who received revelation, from Noah to Jesus; None more wrong than one who falsely claims revelation or says he can send down the like of God's; 'How can you say We are wise, and the Torah of YHWH is with us?' The lying pen of the scribes has made it a lie; The prophet is sent to warn 'the mother of towns' (umm al-qura, Mecca) and those around it; False prophet put to death [divergence between the texts]; The Torah contains guidance and light; Angels (God's messengers) take the souls of the dying; False prophet put to death; If God wills he takes you away and brings another people in your place; and 1 more.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/02-hb-quran.yaml).

Shared motifs, rarest first: The Ten Commandments (Decalogue) [divergence between the texts] (weight 6.7); Honor father and mother, with the promise of long life [divergence between the texts] (weight 6.0); Prohibitions of murder, adultery, theft and false witness [divergence between the texts] (weight 5.8); The Ten Commandments (Decalogue) (weight 5.4); Honor father and mother, with the promise of long life (weight 5.3); Prohibitions of murder, adultery, theft and false witness (weight 5.1). Pair score 34.3.

Only in The Ten Words and the people's fear: God identifies himself as the one who brought Israel out of Egypt, the house of slaves; The people 'see' the voices or thunder at the revelation; Do not take God's name in vain; The prophet approaches the thick darkness where God is; Sexual relations with a neighbor's wife are forbidden [divergence between the texts]; Prohibition of coveting the neighbor's wife and property [divergence between the texts]; Do not kill the soul God has made sacred except by right [divergence between the texts]; No other gods before YHWH [divergence between the texts]; The ground and the reward of the duty to parents [divergence between the texts]; The Sabbath is justified by God's resting on the seventh day of creation; The Sabbath was imposed only on those who differed about it [response between the texts]; Do not stretch your eyes toward the worldly splendor given to others to test them; and 8 more.

Only in The recited commandments (the Quranic decalogue): List of commandments introduced 'Come, I will recite what your Lord has forbidden you'; Lest you say scripture was sent only to two groups before us; This is my straight path; follow it and not other ways that scatter you; God gave Moses the book complete and detailing everything; Do not kill your children for fear of poverty; God provides for them and you; Stand firm for justice as witnesses for God even against yourselves, parents and kin, rich or poor; Guardians must keep orphans' property intact and hand it over when they come of age; Keep the law, turning neither to the right nor to the left; I set before you life and death, blessing and curse: choose life; God burdens no soul beyond its capacity; Honest balances, weights, ephah and hin are commanded.

matches.label: The Ten Commandments (Decalogue)
matches.note: A recited list of commandments compared item by item. Kept: no other gods (allā tushrikū bihi shayʾan = lōʾ yihyeh-ləkhā ʾĕlōhîm ʾăḥērîm), parents, killing, sexual sin, false speech. Omitted: the Sabbath (zākhôr ʾet-yôm haš-šabbāt) and coveting; the image ban is folded into 'associate nothing'. Added: allā taqtulū awlādakum min imlāqin, the orphan's property, full measure and weight, keeping God's covenant. The prologue ʾānōkhî YHWH ʾĕlōhêkhā ʾăšer hôṣēʾtîkhā mē-ʾereṣ miṣrayim becomes qul taʿālaw atlu mā ḥarrama rabbukum, without the Exodus.

passages.text: אָֽנֹכִ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אֲשֶׁ֧ר הוֹצֵאתִ֛יךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים
לֹֽ֣א יִהְיֶֽה לְךָ֛ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים עַל פָּנָֽיַ
זָכ֛וֹר אֶת י֥וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֖ת לְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ

قُلْ تَعَالَوْا۟ أَتْلُ مَا حَرَّمَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ أَلَّا تُشْرِكُوا۟ بِهِۦ شَيْـًٔا وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَٰنًا وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَٰدَكُم مِّنْ إِمْلَٰقٍ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكُمْ وَإِيَّاهُمْ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ مَالَ ٱلْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَأَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَإِذَا قُلْتُمْ فَٱعْدِلُوا۟ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰ وَبِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْفُوا۟ ذَٰلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
وَأَنَّ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطِى مُسْتَقِيمًا فَٱتَّبِعُوهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلسُّبُلَ فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمْ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ذَٰلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ

passages.text: כַּבֵּ֥ד אֶת אָבִ֖יךָ וְאֶת אִמֶּ֑ךָ לְמַ֨עַן֙ יַאֲרִכ֣וּן יָמֶ֔יךָ עַ֚ל הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ

sides.note: kabbēd ʾet-ʾābîkā wəʾet-ʾimmekā ləmaʿan yaʾărikûn yāmêkā; wa-bi-l-wālidayni iḥsānan immā yablughanna ʿindaka l-kibara ... fa-lā taqul lahumā uffin ... wa-qul rabbi rḥamhumā ka-mā rabbayānī ṣaghīrā. Q drops the promise of long life and puts in its place care for parents in old age and a prayer for them. Duty to parents comes second, right after God, in both.

passages.text: قُلْ تَعَالَوْا۟ أَتْلُ مَا حَرَّمَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ أَلَّا تُشْرِكُوا۟ بِهِۦ شَيْـًٔا وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَٰنًا وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَٰدَكُم مِّنْ إِمْلَٰقٍ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكُمْ وَإِيَّاهُمْ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

sides.note: Deut: kabbēd ʾet-ʾāvîkhā wə-ʾet-ʾimmekhā ... ləmaʿan yaʾărîkhūn yāmêkhā û-ləmaʿan yîṭav lākh ʿal-hā-ʾădāmāh. Q: wa-bi-l-wālidayni iḥsānan. 'Honour' becomes 'kindness', and the promise of long life in the land is dropped.

לֹ֖א תִּרְצָֽח
לֹ֖א תִּנְאָֽף

sides.note: The same sequence: no other god, no killing, no adultery, no false witness: lā yadʿūna maʿa llāhi ilāhan ākhara wa-lā yaqtulūna n-nafsa llatī ḥarrama llāhu illā bi-l-ḥaqqi wa-lā yaznūna ... lā yashhadūna z-zūra ~ lōʾ yihyeh ləkhā ʾĕlōhîm ʾăḥērîm ... lōʾ tirṣāḥ lōʾ tinʾāf ... lōʾ taʿăneh və-rēʿăkā ʿēd šāqer. Changes: the absolute lōʾ tirṣāḥ gets an exception ('except by right', illā bi-l-ḥaqq); theft is left out; the commands become a description of the righteous (alladhīna lā ...), followed by doubled punishment and an exception for those who repent (25:69-70).

وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ مَالَ ٱلْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَأَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَإِذَا قُلْتُمْ فَٱعْدِلُوا۟ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰ وَبِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْفُوا۟ ذَٰلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

sides.note: Deut: lōʾ tirṣāḥ; wə-lōʾ tinʾāf; wə-lōʾ-taʿăneh və-rēʿăkhā ʿēd šāwʾ, absolute. Q qualifies and widens: wa-lā taqtulū l-nafsa llatī ḥarrama llāhu illā bi-l-ḥaqqi (with an exception); wa-lā taqrabū l-fawāḥisha mā ẓahara minhā wa-mā baṭana (all indecency, not only adultery); wa-idhā qultum fa-ʿdilū wa-law kāna dhā qurbā (just speech even against kin). Theft is absent.

leads.title: Against the false prophets and the women who hunt souls ↔ Abraham's line of eighteen prophets; Torah in sheets; the false claimant

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/02-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: None more wrong than one who falsely claims revelation or says he can send down the like of God's (weight 6.7). Pair score 6.7.

Only in Against the false prophets and the women who hunt souls: False prophets will not be in the council of God's people nor written in the register of the house of Israel; The prophets of Israel are like foxes (jackals) among ruins; Diviners profane God for handfuls of barley and crumbs of bread; False prophets mislead the people saying 'Peace' when there is no peace; The true prophet's task is to go up into the breaches and build a wall for the people on the day of battle; false prophets did not; God tears off the magic bands and lets the trapped souls go free 'like birds' (leporhot); Women prophetesses sew bands (kesatot) on wrists and make veils (mispahot) for heads to hunt souls, killing and keeping alive by magic; Parable: one who builds on the brink of a crumbling bank falls with it into hell; Kings or people practice divination (qesem) and augury (nihush); Whether a prophet takes payment for his message [contrast between the texts]; False prophets daub a flimsy wall with whitewash (tafel); God's storm, flood-rain and hailstones bring it down; Refuge from the evil of those (women) who blow on knots (al-naffathat fi al-'uqad), i.e. knot-tying sorcery; and 3 more.

Only in Abraham's line of eighteen prophets; Torah in sheets; the false claimant: Opponents say 'God has sent down nothing to any human'; The intercessors they claimed as partners are not seen with them; ties are cut; They make Moses' book into sheets (qarāṭīs), showing some and hiding much; Catalogue of prophets who received revelation, from Noah to Jesus; 'How can you say We are wise, and the Torah of YHWH is with us?' The lying pen of the scribes has made it a lie; The prophet is sent to warn 'the mother of towns' (umm al-qura, Mecca) and those around it; False prophet put to death [divergence between the texts]; 'Naked I came from my mother's womb and naked I shall return there'; The Torah contains guidance and light; Angels (God's messengers) take the souls of the dying; False prophet put to death; If God wills he takes you away and brings another people in your place; and 1 more.

leads.title: Sour grapes - individual responsibility and repentance ↔ Tenfold reward; my life and death for God; no bearer bears another's burden
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 same element.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/02-hb-quran.yaml).

Shared motifs, rarest first: 'The soul that sins, it shall die': the son does not bear the father's iniquity nor the father the son's (weight 6.3); Fathers not put to death for children nor children for fathers (weight 5.8). Pair score 12.1.

Only in Sour grapes - individual responsibility and repentance: Exhortation: cast away your transgressions and make yourselves a new heart and a new spirit; why will you die?; Test case of three generations: righteous father, violent son, and a grandson who sees his father's sins and does not imitate them; Whether one person can carry another's sin [divergence between the texts]; No one may excuse himself on judgment day because his ancestors associated partners; If the wicked turns from his sins, none of his transgressions will be remembered; if the righteous turns away, his righteousness is forgotten; Catalogue of the righteous man: no eating on the mountains, no idols, no adultery, no menstrual intercourse, no oppression, returns pledges, feeds the hungry, clothes the naked, no interest; Proverb 'The fathers have eaten sour grapes and the children's teeth are set on edge', abolished by God; Whether repentance has a time limit [divergence between the texts]; People complain 'the way of the Lord is not fair'; God answers that it is their ways that are unfair; God does not desire the death of the wicked but that he turn from his way and live; A cloak taken in pledge must be returned before sunset; Whoever does good does it for his own soul; whoever does evil, it is against it; and 3 more.

Only in Tenfold reward; my life and death for God; no bearer bears another's burden: On the day some of the signs come, faith not believed before will not avail; My prayer, my rites, my living and my dying are for God, Lord of the worlds; God made you successors (khalāʾif) on the earth and raised some above others in rank to test you; The Prophet is commanded to be the first of those who submit (awwal al-muslimīn); God multiplies a good deed (tenfold) while an evil deed is requited only by its like; Whether guilt passes from parents to their descendants [contrast between the texts]; Those who split their religion into sects, each party exulting in what it has; Follow the religion (milla) of Abraham the ḥanīf, who was no idolater; Each person dies for his own sin.

leads.title: Creation in six days and the seventh-day rest ↔ Darkness and light, clay and two terms, and those who would not believe
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 deliberately changed.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/02-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: Whether darkness is made by God or exists before creation [divergence between the texts] (weight 6.7). Pair score 6.7.

Only in Creation in six days and the seventh-day rest: Deity gives names to the elements it creates (day, night, heaven, earth, seas); Deity rests on the seventh day after creating, and sanctifies it; The earth itself is commanded to bring forth plants or animals; Light exists before the sun and moon are made; Humans and animals originally given only plants as food; Creation proceeds by dividing (light/darkness, waters above/below); Deity rests on the seventh day after creating, and sanctifies it [divergence between the texts]; A divine wind or spirit hovers or moves over the primeval waters; God made every living thing from water [divergence between the texts]; God speaks to heavenly beings about making man [divergence between the texts]; The heavens and earth were a closed-up mass (ratq) that God split apart (fatq) [divergence between the texts]; The form God gave humans at creation [divergence between the texts]; and 27 more.

Only in Darkness and light, clay and two terms, and those who would not believe: Had God sent an angel he would have made him a man; Even a book on parchment they could touch would be called magic; God destroyed earlier generations though he had established them more firmly and given them rain and rivers; Praise God who created heaven and earth and made the darknesses and the light; Earlier messengers were mocked, and what the mockers mocked surrounded them; God decreed a term (ajal) for each person, and another term named with him; Deniers demand that a treasure be sent down to the prophet or an angel come with him; The speaker too was 'pinched off from clay' (qoratsti), like a figure nipped from a lump of clay; 'I form light and create darkness, make peace and create evil (ra'); I YHWH do all these'; God appears as three men who visit the patriarch; The listeners walk among the dwellings of generations God destroyed, a sign; First human shaped from dust, clay or soil.

matches.label: Whether darkness is made by God or exists before creation
matches.note: Gen: wə-ḥōšekh ʿal-pənê təhôm already exists, God says yəhî ʾôr and then separates (wa-yyavdēl ... bên hā-ʾôr û-vên ha-ḥōšekh). Only light is created. Lev puts on the altar ha-ḥēlev ha-məkhasseh ʾet-haq-qerev wə-ʾēt kol-ha-ḥēlev ʾăšer ʿal-haq-qerev (the fat on the entrails) and ha-ʾalyāh təmîmāh lə-ʿummat he-ʿāṣeh (the fat tail by the backbone). leads.title: Psalm 104, the great creation hymn (cf. the Great Hymn to the Aten) ↔ Splitter of seed and dawn; stars for navigation; do not revile their gods

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/02-hb-quran.yaml).

Only in Splitter of seed and dawn; stars for navigation; do not revile their gods: Do not revile those they invoke besides God, lest they revile God in ignorance; They made the jinn partners of God, though he created them; Humans have a lodging place and a repository (mustaqarr wa-mustawdaʿ); Opponents say to the Prophet 'you have studied' (darasta); Rain brings forth vegetation: clustered grain, hanging date clusters, vineyards, olives and pomegranates; God is the splitter of the dawn (fāliq al-iṣbāḥ); night for rest; God splits the grain and the date-stone; Vision does not grasp him, but he grasps all vision; Do not revile God or curse a ruler of your people; God has taken neither consort (sahiba) nor child; God made the stars for guidance in the darknesses of land and sea; God brings the living out of the dead and the dead out of the living; and 5 more.

Only in Eat what God's name is spoken over; the opened breast; jinn and humans judged: Parable: one who was dead whom God revived and gave a light to walk among people; God knows best where to place his message; In every town God placed its great criminals to plot there; Jinn led many humans astray; their human allies say 'we profited from one another'; Messengers came to both jinn and humans 'from among you'; Paradise as the abode of peace (dār al-salām); Every prophet has enemies: devils of humans and jinn inspiring one another with gilded speech; Eat only what God's name was pronounced over; what was slaughtered without it is forbidden; The people walking in darkness have seen a great light; on those in the land of deathly shadow light has shone; Forbidden food is permitted to one compelled by necessity, without desire or transgression; God does not punish a people before sending a messenger, lest they plead they had none; If God wills he takes you away and brings another people in your place.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/02-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: 'He spoke and it came to be; he commanded and it stood firm' (weight 6.3); Deity creates by spoken command (Let there be...) (weight 5.8). Pair score 12.1.

Only in Psalm 33 - by the word of YHWH the heavens were made: God frustrates the counsel of the nations; his own counsel stands forever; By the word of YHWH the heavens were made and all their host by the breath of his mouth; No king is saved by a great army; the horse is a vain hope for victory; God gathers the waters of the sea as a heap and puts the deeps in storehouses; God, who fashions the hearts of all and observes all their deeds, looks down from his dwelling; Psalm in Book I lacking any superscription; God looks down from heaven on humankind to see if any seek him; Praise with lyre and ten-stringed harp (nevel asor); Beatitude formula 'Happy (ashrei) is the man who...'; Call to sing a new song (shir hadash) to God; God creates by saying to a thing 'Be' and it is (kun fa-yakun).

Only in Rescue in the darkness of land and sea; the bewildered man; the trumpet: Parable: one lured by devils, bewildered in the land, while companions call him to guidance; God can send punishment from above you or from beneath your feet, or split you into factions; Do not sit with those who plunge into mockery of God's signs until they change the subject; The damned are given a drink of boiling water (hamim); Those who split their religion into sects, each party exulting in what it has; Sailors in a storm call on God sincerely, vow thanks, and transgress once saved [divergence between the texts]; God raises a storm that lifts ships to the heavens and down to the deeps, then hushes it to a whisper and brings sailors to harbor; Each wrongdoer would ransom himself with all that is on earth, if he could; When harm touches people they turn to God; when he gives them relief a party of them associates partners again; The trumpet (ṣūr) is blown and the dead are gathered.

leads.title: Psalm 50 - God summons heaven and earth; do I eat the flesh of bulls ↔ Mercy written on himself; the idolaters' denial at the gathering
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 same element.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/02-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: God does not need sacrifices: 'If I were hungry I would not tell you... Do I eat the flesh of bulls or drink the blood of goats?' (weight 5.8). Pair score 5.8.

Only in Psalm 50 - God summons heaven and earth; do I eat the flesh of bulls: Superscription ascribes the psalm to Asaph; Every beast of the forest is mine, the cattle on a thousand hills, and the ziz of the field; God's faithful ones made a covenant with him by sacrifice; Our God comes and is not silent; fire devours before him and a tempest rages around him; Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines forth (hofia); 'I kept silent, and you thought I was one like yourself'; An oath invoking God by a repeated triple title (El, Elohim, YHWH); Whether God is in need and humans rich [contrast between the texts]; Offer to God a sacrifice of thanksgiving (todah) and pay your vows to Elyon; God rebukes the wicked who recites his statutes and covenant yet consorts with thieves and adulterers; Poet summons heaven and earth to listen; Wonder done 'so that you may know that the earth belongs to YHWH'; and 4 more.

Only in Mercy written on himself; the idolaters' denial at the gathering: On the day of the Hour they carry their burdens (awzār) on their backs; Standing before the fire the damned wish to be sent back; were they sent back they would return to sin; Unbelievers say there is only this worldly life and no raising; God feeds and is not fed; The idolaters swear 'by God our Lord, we were not idolaters'; The Prophet is commanded to be the first of those who submit (awwal al-muslimīn); The People of the Book recognize the truth as they recognize their own sons; Prophet commissioned to make the people's heart fat, ears heavy and eyes shut lest they understand and be healed [divergence between the texts]; God has prescribed mercy for himself (kataba ʿalā nafsihi l-raḥma); On judgment day God asks 'Where are my partners for whom you contended?'; The life of this world is only play and diversion; the last abode is better; God mocks: where are their gods who ate the fat of their sacrifices? let them rise and help; and 2 more.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/02-hb-quran.yaml).

Only in Psalm 74, the burned sanctuary and God who crushed the heads of Leviathan: Call 'Arise, O God, plead your own cause'; Prayer not to hand the soul of God's turtledove to the wild beast; God is king from of old (qedem), working salvation in the midst of the earth; God broke the heads of the sea dragons (tanninim) on the waters; Enemies burn all the meeting places (mo'adei El) of God in the land; God crushed the heads (plural) of Leviathan, the many-headed sea serpent; Complaint that there are no signs and no prophet anymore, none who knows how long; God split or shattered the sea (Yam) by his might; God split open springs and torrents and dried up ever-flowing rivers; God fixed all the boundaries of the earth and formed summer and winter; The slain Leviathan is given as food to the desert creatures or people; Enemies roar in the sanctuary, hack its carved work with axes and burn it to the ground [divergence between the texts]; and 5 more.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/02-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: When harm touches people they turn to God; when he gives them relief a party of them associates partners again (weight 5.4). Pair score 5.4.

Only in Psalm 78, Asaph's historical recital from Egypt to David: God sends a band (mishlahat) of 'evil angels' (mal'akhei ra'im) to execute his wrath; Manna called 'bread of the mighty ones' (lehem abbirim), i.e. food of angels; God struck his enemies backward/in the rear (read by rabbis as the Philistines' hemorrhoids); The exodus wonders are located in 'the field of Zoan' (Tanis); The Lord awakes as from sleep like a warrior shouting from wine; God remembers that humans are flesh, a breath that passes and does not return; God rejected the tent of Joseph and tribe of Ephraim and chose Judah and Mount Zion; In the catastrophe young men are consumed by fire, maidens have no wedding song, widows do not lament; God built his sanctuary like the heights (or heavens) and like the earth founded forever; God took David from the sheepfolds, from following the nursing ewes, to shepherd his people; The ark of God is captured by enemies; God commanded the skies and opened the doors (or windows) of heaven; and 40 more.

Only in The Prophet consoled; a ladder to the sky; animals as communities: Every beast on earth and bird flying with its wings are communities (umam) like you, gathered to their Lord; The Prophet is consoled: messengers before him were denied and patient until help came; We have neglected nothing in the Book; God opened the gates of everything to them, and when they rejoiced he seized them suddenly; If you could seek a tunnel into the earth or a ladder into the sky to bring them a sign...; A ladder (sullam / sullām) reaching from earth to heaven; The prophet disclaims having God's treasuries, knowing the unseen, or being an angel; Animals are in God's care and are gathered before him; The paired extremes of digging into the earth and climbing to the sky; Had God willed he would have made all humanity a single community; None can change the words of God; The unbelievers demand: 'Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?'; and 1 more.

leads.title: A cleansing fountain, the end of prophecy, and the struck shepherd ↔ Abraham's line of eighteen prophets; Torah in sheets; the false claimant
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 shared wording.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/02-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: False prophet put to death (weight 5.8). Pair score 5.8.

Only in A cleansing fountain, the end of prophecy, and the struck shepherd: A fountain is opened for the house of David and Jerusalem to cleanse sin and menstrual impurity (niddah); Prophets wear a hairy mantle (adderet se'ar) as a mark of office, here to deceive; Disclaimer: 'I am no prophet; I am a tiller of the soil'; If anyone still prophesies, his own father and mother will pierce him through for speaking falsely in God's name; In that day God cuts off the names of idols and removes the prophets and the spirit of impurity from the land; 'Awake, sword, against my shepherd, the man who is my fellow; strike the shepherd and the sheep will scatter'; Two-thirds perish and one third is brought through fire, refined like silver and tested like gold; Asked about the wounds 'between your hands', the man says 'I was struck in the house of my friends (lovers)'; Command to destroy figured stones, molten images and high places of the land; Mutual declaration: Israel avows YHWH as God, YHWH avows Israel as his treasured people.

Only in Abraham's line of eighteen prophets; Torah in sheets; the false claimant: Opponents say 'God has sent down nothing to any human'; The intercessors they claimed as partners are not seen with them; ties are cut; They make Moses' book into sheets (qarāṭīs), showing some and hiding much; Catalogue of prophets who received revelation, from Noah to Jesus; None more wrong than one who falsely claims revelation or says he can send down the like of God's; 'How can you say We are wise, and the Torah of YHWH is with us?' The lying pen of the scribes has made it a lie; The prophet is sent to warn 'the mother of towns' (umm al-qura, Mecca) and those around it; False prophet put to death [divergence between the texts]; 'Naked I came from my mother's womb and naked I shall return there'; The Torah contains guidance and light; Angels (God's messengers) take the souls of the dying; If God wills he takes you away and brings another people in your place; and 1 more.

Only in The recited commandments (the Quranic decalogue): List of commandments introduced 'Come, I will recite what your Lord has forbidden you'; Lest you say scripture was sent only to two groups before us; This is my straight path; follow it and not other ways that scatter you; God gave Moses the book complete and detailing everything; The Ten Commandments (Decalogue) [divergence between the texts]; Stand firm for justice as witnesses for God even against yourselves, parents and kin, rich or poor; Prohibitions of murder, adultery, theft and false witness [divergence between the texts]; Keep the law, turning neither to the right nor to the left; I set before you life and death, blessing and curse: choose life; God burdens no soul beyond its capacity; Prohibitions of murder, adultery, theft and false witness.

passages.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יוֹאָ֡שׁ לְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁר עָמְד֨וּ עָלָ֜יו הַאַתֶּ֣ם תְּרִיב֣וּן לַבַּ֗עַל אִם אַתֶּם֙ תּוֹשִׁיע֣וּן אוֹת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֥יב ל֛וֹ יוּמַ֖ת עַד הַבֹּ֑קֶר אִם אֱלֹהִ֥ים הוּא֙ יָ֣רֶב ל֔וֹ כִּ֥י נָתַ֖ץ אֶֽת מִזְבְּחֽוֹ
וַיִּקְרָא ל֥וֹ בַיּוֹם הַה֖וּא יְרֻבַּ֣עַל לֵאמֹ֑ר יָ֤רֶב בּוֹ֙ הַבַּ֔עַל כִּ֥י נָתַ֖ץ אֶֽת מִזְבְּחֽוֹ

sides.note: The same argument from the idol's helplessness: ʾim-ʾĕlōhîm hûʾ yāreb lô kî nātaṣ ʾet-mizbəḥô, 'if he is a god let him contend for himself'; bal faʿalahu kabīruhum hādhā fa-sʾalūhum in kānū yanṭiqūn, 'ask them, if they can speak'. In Judg the idolatrous father Joash says it to protect his son; in Q Abraham says it to shame the people, and they are turned on their heads (nukisū ʿalā ruʾūsihim).

passages.text: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ

leads.summary: أَمْن (ʾamn, “security”) occurs in 5 verses; 3 of them (60%) are in the Abraham narrative, which is 3% of the Quran, across 2 surahs. The more common same-gloss word مُؤْمِن (muʾmin, 193 verses) has only 3% of its verses there.

passages.text: وَإِذْ جَعَلْنَا ٱلْبَيْتَ مَثَابَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَمْنًا وَٱتَّخِذُوا۟ مِن مَّقَامِ إِبْرَٰهِۦمَ مُصَلًّى وَعَهِدْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِۦمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ أَن طَهِّرَا بَيْتِىَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَٱلْعَٰكِفِينَ وَٱلرُّكَّعِ ٱلسُّجُودِ

وَإِذَا جَآءَهُمْ أَمْرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْنِ أَوِ ٱلْخَوْفِ أَذَاعُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَلَوْ رَدُّوهُ إِلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ وَإِلَىٰٓ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَمْرِ مِنْهُمْ لَعَلِمَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَنۢبِطُونَهُۥ مِنْهُمْ وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ لَٱتَّبَعْتُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
وَكَيْفَ أَخَافُ مَآ أَشْرَكْتُمْ وَلَا تَخَافُونَ أَنَّكُمْ أَشْرَكْتُم بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ عَلَيْكُمْ سُلْطَٰنًا فَأَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ أَحَقُّ بِٱلْأَمْنِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنَهُم بِظُلْمٍ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلْأَمْنُ وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ

وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَيَسْتَخْلِفَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمَا ٱسْتَخْلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ دِينَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى ٱرْتَضَىٰ لَهُمْ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ أَمْنًا يَعْبُدُونَنِى لَا يُشْرِكُونَ بِى شَيْـًٔا وَمَن كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ

وَجَٰوَزْنَا بِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَأَتَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ يَعْكُفُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَصْنَامٍ لَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَى ٱجْعَل لَّنَآ إِلَٰهًا كَمَا لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ
وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدَ ءَامِنًا وَٱجْنُبْنِى وَبَنِىَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ ٱلْأَصْنَامَ
وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
